scope: C03 original Blob wrapper parameter and judgement mapping
evidenceType: source-confirmed static decompilation; runtime corroboration from sdk-vs-moduleframe-parameter-boundary.json

notes: SetParam forwards many keys through SDK vtable slot 0x60; SelectByCircularuty is wrapper spelling translated to SDK key SelectByCircularity.
MinCenterBias and MaxCenterBias are converted from floating text to integer text and forwarded as MinCenterBiasEx/MaxCenterBiasEx.
Enable/Low/High limit families are stored in CIMVSBlobFindModu state and consumed by LimitJudge; they are not direct SDK threshold fields.
FindNum, MinArea, MaxArea and other scalar keys reach the SDK forwarding tail, but the decompiler does not prove the underlying SDK value type for every key.
SetParam source contains an existing spelling typo: HightThreshold/HightSoftThreshold.

sourceConfirmed: Null output returns -0x1fffffff; null internal judgement buffer returns -0x1ffffffe; blob count >= 20001 returns -0x1ffffffd; null SDK blob result returns -0x1ffffceb.
For each blob, the module evaluates enabled count/total-area and per-blob area, centroid X/Y, center X/Y, box height/width, perimeter, long/short axis, circularity and rectangularity limits.
Per-blob pass bits are ANDed into this+0x15da0 and written to the judgement buffer at this+0x15d98; OKWhenNumIsZero initializes the module status from zero-count state.
LimitJudge runs after ProcessAlg and before ProcessOutput in Process.
unknowns: Exact SDK vtable slot-to-property names and the native layout of _BLOB_FIND_MODU_OUTPUT remain ABI-sensitive.

runtimeCorroboration.observed: 108 ModuleFrame fields produced 41 direct SDK accepted and 67 rejected by direct SDK SetRunParam; replay remained 47 blobs/973202, so ModuleFrame export is a wrapper state surface rather than a 1:1 SDK parameter list.

reconstructionGuidance: Implement wrapper state and LimitJudge before attempting VM parity; do not replay all ModuleFrame fields directly into the SDK.
